title: Given Reviewer
subject: Technopreneurship
instructions: Read each question carefully. Choose the best answer.
answerKeySource: Marked/circled answers from the uploaded quiz images, checked and cleaned against the uploaded BM2506 Technopreneurship Prelim handout where supported.

questions.question: A team includes developers, designers, marketers, and end-users in ideation sessions. What principle is being utilized?

choices.A: Assigning ideation to technical experts only

questions.explanation: Including people with different roles and viewpoints brings diverse perspectives into the ideation process.

questions.question: Which emerging technology enables secure digital transactions and smart contracts?
questions.explanation: Blockchain is the marked answer for secure digital transactions and smart contracts.

questions.question: A startup runs out of cash after building products for the wrong segment. What failure pattern does this reflect?

choices.A: Delays in launching the product to the market
choices.B: Resource waste from targeting the wrong customer segment
choices.C: Insufficient funding or external investment support
choices.D: Inefficient technical design and system setup

questions.answerText: Resource waste from targeting the wrong customer segment
questions.explanation: The startup spent resources building for the wrong customer segment, which led to waste and cash loss.

questions.question: Which thinking approach emphasizes starting with a real and persistent problem before developing solutions?
questions.explanation: Problem-first thinking begins with a real and persistent problem before deciding on a solution.

questions.question: A founder launches a product just before an industry shift occurs, gaining an early-mover advantage. Which benefit of a macro perspective enabled this outcome?

choices.B: Anticipating change rather than reacting late
choices.C: Narrowing focus to a single customer group
choices.D: Reacting quickly to internal operational failures

questions.answerText: Anticipating change rather than reacting late
questions.explanation: The founder benefited by anticipating an industry change before it happened.

questions.question: In customer segmentation, what does the abbreviation B2C stand for?
questions.explanation: B2C stands for Business to Consumer.

questions.question: What factor primarily enables technopreneurial ventures to scale rapidly globally compared with traditional businesses?

choices.A: Heavy reliance on inventory and facilities
choices.C: Use of digital platforms with global accessibility
choices.D: Gradual physical expansion across regional markets

questions.answerText: Use of digital platforms with global accessibility
questions.explanation: Digital platforms make it possible to reach users globally without relying only on physical expansion.

questions.question: A team checks whether a proposed solution addresses a real customer problem and aligns with customer needs. What alignment is being ensured?
questions.explanation: Customer Problem Fit measures how well a startup's idea aligns with real customer needs and actual customer challenges.

questions.question: Which historical period marked the rise of digital entrepreneurs and technopreneurs?
questions.explanation: The 21st Century is the marked period associated with the rise of digital entrepreneurs and technopreneurs.

questions.question: A product is priced too high because the founders misjudged what users value and can afford. What mistake was made?

choices.D: Incorrect pricing due to poor customer understanding

questions.answerText: Incorrect pricing due to poor customer understanding
questions.explanation: The pricing problem came from misunderstanding what customers value and are willing or able to pay.

questions.question: Which rule of brainstorming prevents negative feedback and judgment during the idea-generation process?

choices.C: No criticism of ideas or people

questions.answerText: No criticism of ideas or people
questions.explanation: This rule keeps idea generation judgment-free so participants can contribute freely.

questions.question: A startup aligns its platform with sustainability goals and emerging digital trends to improve adoption. What macro benefit is demonstrated?
questions.explanation: The startup is aligning its innovation with broader sustainability goals and changing societal needs.

questions.question: Which type of entrepreneurship is exemplified when a startup is built entirely around an emerging digital technology rather than an existing business model?

choices.B: Traditional entrepreneurship focused on physical operations

questions.explanation: A startup built fundamentally around emerging technology is an example of technopreneurship.

questions.question: A startup maps demographics, motivations, frustrations, and behaviors of its target users. What tool is being developed?
questions.explanation: A customer persona represents target users using information such as demographics, motivations, frustrations, and behaviors.

questions.question: Which risk is reduced when startups deeply understand user behaviors and pain points?
questions.explanation: Understanding users helps reduce the risk of building a product that does not fit real customer needs.

questions.question: A founder analyzes global climate agreements and international emissions policies before developing a scalable solution. Which level of analysis is emphasized?

choices.A: Micro view focused on personal initiatives
choices.D: Macro view at the industry contribution level

questions.explanation: The super-macro view focuses on global agreements, policies, and collaborations such as emissions goals and international initiatives.

questions.question: Which ideation technique emphasizes rapid, judgment-free idea generation?
questions.explanation: Brainstorming emphasizes generating ideas freely before evaluating them.

questions.question: A competitor outperforms a startup by designing better features and messaging for the same users. What explains this outcome?
questions.explanation: Better understanding of the same users can lead to more relevant features and messaging.

questions.question: Which outcome BEST reflects technology’s role in creating entirely new industries such as fintech and telemedicine?

choices.A: Improvement of existing manual systems only
choices.B: Expansion of traditional industries without innovation
choices.C: Emergence of new products, services, and industries
choices.D: Reduction of employment and business opportunities

questions.answerText: Emergence of new products, services, and industries
questions.explanation: Fintech and telemedicine are examples of new products, services, and industries made possible by technological progress.

questions.question: What concept measures how well a startup's idea aligns with real customer needs rather than just technical appeal?
questions.explanation: Customer Problem Fit checks whether the identified problem matches actual customer challenges and whether the proposed solution aligns with customer needs.

questions.question: A family business modernizes operations after recognizing the global growth of e-commerce. What macro benefit is applied?
questions.explanation: Recognizing a broad e-commerce trend can help a family business introduce fresh and innovative approaches.

questions.question: Which term refers to the complete context surrounding a problem, including people, environment, and constraints?
questions.explanation: A problem space includes the problem itself together with the people, environment, and constraints surrounding it.

questions.question: A startup team delays selecting a final idea to explore multiple alternatives first. What benefit of team-based ideation is being applied?

choices.B: Avoiding premature commitment to one solution

questions.answerText: Avoiding premature commitment to one solution
questions.explanation: Exploring several alternatives before selecting one helps prevent committing too early.

questions.question: Which leadership concept emphasizes innovation, vision, and strategic risk-taking to drive business growth?
questions.explanation: Entrepreneurial leadership combines innovation, vision, initiative, and strategic risk-taking.

questions.question: A team records all ideas first and evaluates them only after grouping and categorizing them. Which brainstorming stage is demonstrated?
questions.explanation: Ideas are generated first and judged later, keeping evaluation separate from idea generation.

questions.question: An entrepreneur repeatedly reacts to crises rather than anticipating trends, leading to stress and missed opportunities. What risk of ignoring the macro view is illustrated?

choices.C: Building solutions aligned with market demand

questions.explanation: Reacting repeatedly to crises instead of anticipating changes is described as constantly putting out fires.

questions.question: Which framework states that customers “hire” products to accomplish a job?
questions.explanation: JTBD views products as things customers 'hire' to accomplish a particular job.

questions.question: A technopreneur maps users, environment, and constraints before building a solution. What is being defined?
questions.explanation: Mapping users, environment, and constraints helps define the complete problem space.

questions.question: What business outcome is achieved when e-commerce platforms and mobile apps extend services to global audiences?

choices.A: Expansion of customer reach and experience

questions.answerText: Expansion of customer reach and experience
questions.explanation: Digital platforms can expand customer reach by making services accessible to global audiences.

questions.question: Which type of innovation is associated with technopreneurship?
questions.explanation: Technopreneurship is associated with disruptive, technology-driven innovation.

questions.question: A team asks whether a solution aligns with the target customer persona before development. What purpose does this serve?
questions.explanation: Checking a solution against a target persona helps determine whether it is relevant and desirable to intended users.

questions.question: What does the concept known as the “genius of the AND” emphasize for technopreneurs when analyzing problems and opportunities?

choices.D: Choosing macro analysis over micro analysis

questions.explanation: The 'genius of the AND' combines big-picture macro analysis with detailed micro analysis.

questions.question: Which historical period is described as allowing startups to scale globally with minimal physical assets?
questions.explanation: The handout states that in the 21st Century Digital and Technopreneurship Era, startups can scale globally with minimal physical assets.

questions.question: A team designs different app features for passengers and drivers within the same platform. What segmentation insight is applied?

choices.A: User roles can be treated as interchangeable.
choices.B: Different user segments have unique needs.
choices.C: Pricing should be the same for all users.
choices.D: A single product fits all users equally.

questions.answerText: Different user segments have unique needs.
questions.explanation: Passengers and drivers are different user segments, so each may need different features and experiences.

questions.question: A startup identifies EV charging shortages as an opportunity for a location-optimization app. Which macro category is primarily analyzed?

choices.C: Industry trends and challenges shaping markets

questions.answerText: Industry trends and challenges shaping markets
questions.explanation: A shortage of EV charging stations is treated as an industry trend or challenge that creates an opportunity.

questions.question: A startup team records all ideas first and evaluates them only after grouping and categorization. Which brainstorming stage is demonstrated?
questions.explanation: The team generates and records ideas first, then evaluates them afterward.

questions.question: Which risk characteristic BEST describes technopreneurship in light of the rapid pace of technological change?

choices.A: Low risk from stable market demand
choices.B: Moderate risk from predictable consumer behavior
choices.C: High risk from fast-evolving technology and uncertainty

questions.answerText: High risk from fast-evolving technology and uncertainty
questions.explanation: Rapid technology changes and uncertainty make technopreneurial ventures relatively high-risk.

questions.question: A team checks whether a new feature truly helps its persona before building it. What benefit of personas is demonstrated?
questions.explanation: Personas can be used as a reference when deciding whether a feature is useful to target users.

questions.question: A startup focuses on usage frequency, loyalty, and spending patterns. Which segmentation basis is applied?
questions.explanation: Usage frequency, loyalty, and spending patterns are behavioral characteristics.

questions.question: A team refines a teletherapy concept to ensure accessibility, privacy, and user benefits. What ideation outcome is demonstrated?
questions.explanation: The concept is being refined around user needs such as accessibility, privacy, and benefits.

questions.question: Which macro-industry category includes public health failures, such as those experienced during the COVID-19 pandemic?
questions.explanation: Public health failures during COVID-19 are classified under social developments in the quiz.

questions.question: A startup differentiates between the person who pays and the person who uses the product. What concept is being applied?
questions.explanation: The buyer pays for the product, while the user is the person who actually uses it.

questions.question: What percentage of startup failures is attributed to “no market need”?
questions.explanation: The quiz marks 42% as the percentage attributed to 'no market need.'

questions.question: Which role of technology is shown when automated tools reduce hours of manual work and improve decision-making accuracy?

choices.A: Technology serves as a replacement for creativity.
choices.B: Technology enables faster and smarter problem-solving.
choices.D: Technology increases dependency on manual labor.

questions.answerText: Technology enables faster and smarter problem-solving.
questions.explanation: Automation can reduce manual work and help people process information and make decisions more efficiently.

questions.question: A startup evaluates how distinctive its idea is compared with competitors. Which guiding question is being addressed?

choices.A: How fast can it be built?

questions.explanation: The startup is directly evaluating the distinctiveness of its idea compared with competitors.

questions.question: A founder designs messaging based on age, income, and education level. Which segmentation method is used?
questions.explanation: Age, income, and education level are demographic characteristics.

questions.question: What distinguishes technopreneurship when a company uses existing technology in inventive ways to deliver new value?

choices.A: Emphasis on local market expansion through outlets
choices.B: Creative integration of technology to transform value delivery
choices.C: Focus on operational efficiency without innovation
choices.D: Dependence on physical resources and manpower

questions.answerText: Creative integration of technology to transform value delivery
questions.explanation: Technopreneurship can use existing technology in inventive ways to create new value.

questions.question: Which emerging technology application allows businesses to predict customer needs and personalize solutions?

choices.A: Artificial intelligence and machine learning analytics

questions.answerText: Artificial intelligence and machine learning analytics
questions.explanation: AI and machine learning analytics can analyze patterns and predict customer needs for more personalized solutions.

questions.question: After ideation, a team evaluates whether the required technology can realistically be built. Which shortlisting criterion is applied?
questions.explanation: Technology feasibility checks whether the required technology can realistically be built.

questions.question: A team maps pain points, JTBD, and customer expectations before refining a solution. Which framework is being applied?
questions.explanation: The team is connecting customer pain points, jobs-to-be-done, and expectations to the solution being refined.
